label: fungivory
definition: A heterotrophic process during which a living entity acquires food and energy by consuming living fungal material.

label: carnivory
definition: A heterotrophic process during which a living entity acquires food and energy from consuming living metazoan (animal) material.

label: detritivory
definition: A decomposition process during which a living entity acquires food and energy by consuming detritus.

label: seed predation
definition: A herbivorous process during which a living entity acquires food and energy by consuming seeds of a plant.

label: bactivory
definition: A heterotrophic process during which a living entity acquires food and energy from consuming bacteria.
